objective_value: <int> Total number of vehicles plus crew duties used to cover all trips.
vehicle_schedule: <dict, key: '{depot_name}'> Mapping from each depot name to a list of vehicle trip chains, where each chain is the ordered sequence of trip IDs covered by one vehicle that starts and returns to that depot.

crew_schedule.depot: <str> Name of the home depot from which this crew duty operates.
crew_schedule.type: <str> Duty type name governing the work rules applied to this duty.
crew_schedule.trips: <list[int]> Ordered sequence of trip IDs covered by this crew duty.
